Embedding request via Azure OpenAI using the azure/ provider prefix — response follows the standard OpenAI embeddings shape that Azure returns unchanged

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.embeddingRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"Hello world\",\"model\":\"azure/text-embedding-ada-002\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.embed(_req)
debugPrint(result.data)
debugPrint(result.data[0].embedding)
```
